title: Calisthenics Volume Circuit
summary: Rep-focused calisthenics: push, pull, dip and leg volume in two 4-round circuits, with in-place cardio bursts between moves to keep the heart rate up.

steps.name: Jumping jacks
steps.cue: Easy pace. Just get breathing.

steps.name: Arm circles
steps.cue: Big circles, both directions.

steps.name: Scapular pull-ups
steps.cue: Straight arms; pull shoulder blades down and back, then relax.

steps.name: Inchworm to push-up
steps.cue: Walk hands out, one push-up, walk back.

steps.name: Air squats
steps.cue: Slow and deep, chest up.

steps.name: High knees
steps.cue: Build to a quick pace.

steps.name: Push-ups
steps.cue: Full range, chest to fist height. Drop to knees to finish the set if needed.

steps.name: High knees
steps.cue: Fast feet, drive the knees to hip height.

steps.name: Dips
steps.cue: Shoulders below elbows, lock out at the top. Bench dips with feet on the floor to scale.

steps.name: Jumping jacks
steps.cue: Quick and light on the toes.

steps.name: Squat jumps
steps.cue: Soft landing straight into the next rep. Air squats to scale.

steps.name: Pull-ups
steps.cue: Chin over the bar, full hang at the bottom. Use the band, or do slow negatives, to get every rep.

steps.name: Mountain climbers
steps.cue: Hips level with shoulders, knees snap in fast.

steps.name: Reverse lunges
steps.cue: Back knee kisses the floor; push up through the front heel.

steps.name: Skater hops
steps.cue: Bound side to side, land on one foot, stay low.

steps.name: Hanging knee raises
steps.cue: No swinging; curl the hips up toward the bar.

steps.name: Burpees
steps.cue: Steady rhythm you can hold. Step back instead of jumping to scale.

steps.name: Plank jacks
steps.cue: Hard plank, jump the feet wide and narrow.

steps.name: Walk in place
steps.cue: Bring the breathing down.

steps.name: Dead hang
steps.cue: Relax the shoulders and let the spine lengthen.

steps.name: Couch stretch
steps.cue: Back knee down, squeeze the glute, tall torso.

steps.name: Child's pose
steps.cue: Arms long, sink the hips back.
